channel.title: The Grant Desk - Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: MIT Museum: BRAIN Programmatic Open Call (public programs)
item.description: MIT Museum · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 1,000 total per selected program, covering all costs including speaker and performer fees, travel, materials and equipment rental; proposals using external funding or smaller budgets welcome. The Museum sets ticket prices and keeps ticket revenue. No application fee.

item.description: The Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · Up to USD 90,000 over two years (stipend and tuition support) toward graduate study; 30 fellowships awarded annually. No application fee.

item.description: Mid Atlantic Arts, with the National Endowment for the Arts and the Mellon Foundation · deadline 24 Feb 2027 · Grants of up to USD 11,000 toward eligible expenses, with a 1:1 cost match required. No application fee.

item.title: Sanford Underground Research Facility: Artist-in-Residence Program 2027 (Lead, South Dakota)
item.description: Sanford Underground Research Facility (SURF) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 5,000 stipend paid in two installments, plus up to USD 5,000 in additional funds the artist may apply for to create the artwork. Transportation (airfare, rental car or mileage), housing and per diem are covered for both visits; a studio space and guided surface and underground tours are provided; return shipping of the exhibition is covered up to USD 7,000.

item.title: Humanity AI: Open Call for Proposals 2026
item.description: Humanity AI (coalition of 10 philanthropies) · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · USD 10 million total pool, grants of USD 75,000 to 1,000,000 across three tiers: Tier 1 USD 75,000-150,000; Tier 2 USD 150,000-500,000; Tier 3 USD 500,000-1,000,000. Grants run up to three years. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Arts in Community Grants 2027
    https://www.southarts.org/grants-opportunities/arts-community-grants
    South Arts · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to USD 10,000 per project, covering artist fees. A dollar-for-dollar cash match is required, so a USD 10,000 request needs USD 10,000 in matching funds. Minimum artist fee is USD 4,000 and the minimum grant request is USD 2,000. No application fee.
  • Guggenheim Fellowship 2027
    https://www.gf.org/program/how-to-apply/
    John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Variable cash grant sized to the applicant's proposed budget and needs; the Foundation does not publish a fixed figure or range, and recent awards have typically run into the tens of thousands of US dollars. Roughly 175 to 200 fellowships are awarded each year across more than 50 fields. The Foundation charges no application fee and has no affiliated application consultants.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• American Academy in Berlin: Berlin Prize Fellowship 2027-28
    https://www.americanacademy.de/apply/apply-for-a-fellowship/
    American Academy in Berlin · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 5,000, plus roundtrip airfare, accommodation at or near the Hans Arnhold Center, partial board, in-house library services and professional networking opportunities. Roughly two dozen fellowships awarded each year. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Creative Residency at Bloedel Reserve: Class of 2027
    https://bloedelreserve.slideroom.com/#/login/program/88209
    Bloedel Reserve · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · USD 22 application fee. Furnished private house on the grounds with linens, stocked kitchen, wi-fi, laundry and use of a smart car; an electric piano is available. Domestic residents receive a USD 1,000 stipend. International residents receive no stipend and may instead submit up to USD 1,000 of expenses for reimbursement. Residents pay for their own meals and their own travel to Bainbridge Island. There is no dedicated studio; residents work in the house.
